posts.description: On Thomasson’s “easy ontology” , existence is easy. There is a K as long as the “application conditions” for the phrase in our language “There is a K ” are satisfied. posts.title: Dimensions and substantial change
posts.description: According to Aquinas, in substantial change, the matter persists. This is philosophically troubling, because matter seems to be identified by form, and in substantial change, the substantial form is replaced by a new one.
